title: GPT-5.1 Instant and GPT-5.1 Thinking System Card Addendum
summary: This GPT-5 system card addendum provides updated safety metrics for GPT-5.1 Instant and Thinking, including new evaluations for mental health and emotional reliance.
body: This GPT-5 system card addendum provides updated safety metrics for GPT-5.1 Instant and Thinking, including new evaluations for mental health and emotional reliance.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了GPT-5.1 Instant与Thinking版本的系统卡补充报告。该报告重点更新了模型的安全评估指标，特别引入了针对心理健康影响与情感依赖风险的专项评估。通过对这些敏感领域的量化分析，OpenAI旨在提升模型在复杂交互场景下的安全性与伦理合规性，为行业评估大模型的人机交互风险提供了新的参考维度。

aiReview.reasonZh: 发布了GPT-5.1的安全评估补充报告，对模型安全性研究具有重要参考价值。
